messages.text: BL-1750 🎵 in progress — BL-458 scenario 05 ('an interrupted step file still tears down its detached process tree') fails before it reaches its subject - fixtureReaperAbnormalExitHarness.js launches the real launch_front_desk.sh against a bare mkdtemp root and gives the bridge 5 s for its token file and 5 s to answer /pipeline, and on this host it throws 'fixture bridge never came up' (red at BL-1738's mint and still red on BL-1738's fix, which does not touch this root); the cause is found and recorded, and the harness brings its bridge up so the scenario tests what it names
